finalText:
React re-renders every child by default whenever the parent re-renders. It does this no matter what the props are, unless you tell it not to.

The fix is `React.memo` around the child. That makes React compare props before re-rendering it.

One catch: if any prop is a function, object, or array made fresh inside the parent each render, `React.memo` still sees it as new. That's because JavaScript treats each new object or function as different, even if it looks the same. Wrap those props in `useCallback` or `useMemo` in the parent to keep them stable.
